tax.text: He called for higher taxes on billionaires to support Social Security, health care, and education.
tax.quote: By asking the people at the top to pay their fair share again, like they used to, we can do incredible things in this country.

wages.text: His jobs and economy platform says he supports workers’ right to unionize and bargain collectively.
wages.quote: Protect worker’s right to unionize and collectively bargain

debt.text: His campaign says he will protect Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Seth is fighting to protect Social Security and Medicare, lower the cost of prescription drugs and health care, expand access to affordable health coverage

schools.text: As state treasurer, he led an initiative to rebuild public school buildings statewide.
schools.quote: spearheaded an initiative to rebuild dozens of school buildings across the state

safety.text: He requested federal funding for emergency response vehicles for the West Warwick Police Department.
safety.quote: The funding will be used to purchase and upfit emergency response vehicles that will allow the police department to improve hazard mitigation, investigations, and personnel and public safety.

guns.text: His campaign says he supports banning assault weapons and high-capacity magazines.
guns.quote: Seth supports banning assault weapons and high capacity magazines, the weapons of war most often used in mass shootings.

abortion.text: He says he will defend women's ability to make their own health care decisions without political interference.
abortion.quote: Seth will always fight for the rights of women to make their own health care decisions without the interference of politicians.

gender.text: He voted against the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which would set eligibility rules based on sex at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: He supports expanding the Affordable Care Act and lowering prescription-drug costs through Medicare negotiation.
health.quote: Support expanding the Affordable Care Act, so Americans have improved access to the care they need

energy.text: He has supported clean-energy projects while also citing their role in lowering energy costs.
energy.quote: reducing energy costs by expanding affordable clean energy

voting.text: He says he supports voting rights legislation including the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.
voting.quote: Fight for voting rights in Congress including supporting the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2021.

tax.text: He says lowering the cost of living requires removing government taxes and regulations.
tax.quote: Lowering the cost of living by removing the heavy hand of government taxes and regulations, will give everyday Rhode Islanders the ability to grow successful and financially secure lives.

housing.text: He proposes streamlining permitting to speed home construction and reduce builders’ costs.
housing.quote: Streamline complex, years-long permitting processes to reduce costs for local builders and instantly speed up the construction of homes for all income levels.

immigration.text: He supports removing undocumented people who commit crimes while also supporting a residency pathway for law-abiding immigrants.
immigration.quote: Vic stands for the rule of law, including the immediate removal of criminal illegals. He supports a pathway to permanent residency for law-abiding, tax-paying foreigners.

guns.text: He opposes restrictive gun laws, including broad bans and red-flag laws, and supports easing concealed-carry rules.
guns.quote: He opposes broad bans, including those targeting so-called “assault weapons.”

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He says he would protect female athletes and oppose policies allowing biological males in girls’ sports.
gender.quote: Protecting Female Athletes and ensuring our daughters have safe, fair, and private spaces.

energy.text: He says he would work to lower energy costs.
energy.quote: Vic will fight to lower energy, housing and grocery costs.

voting.text: He supports mandatory photo ID for voters and federal voter ID standards.
voting.quote: Vic supports requiring a photo ID to verify the identity of every voter.
